description: Archive: show status at session start; keep an exact copy before compaction and when a session ends.

hooks.command: node "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/dist/archive.mjs" session-start 2>/dev/null || echo "{\"systemMessage\":\"🟠 Rootz Archive needs Node.js 22.13 or newer, and node was not found. Your conversations are NOT being archived. Install Node.js 22.13 or newer (see the plugin README), then start a new Claude Code session.\"}"
